name: Tomioka (Gunma, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tomioka city emblem in blue, orange and green: a blue stylised swirl with an orange disc and green stylised leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Tomioka, a city in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 March 2006.

features.role: Tomioka city emblem — a blue stylised swirl with an orange disc and green stylised leaves
